Designed for adaptability across changing environments, the Trailberg Odyssey Windset pairs a lightweight technical hood with streamlined shorts for complete multi-terrain functionality. Built with 4-way stretch grid fabric throughout, the set delivers unrestricted movement, breathable comfort and practical storage for active days on and off the trail.

Engineered for hiking, training and active travel, the Odyssey Hood provides weather resistance with a DWR finish and enhanced airflow through power mesh ventilation, while the Odyssey 2.0 shorts offers a comfortable fit with zip cargo style pockets for all-day comfort across varied terrain. Secure zipped pockets and reflective detailing across both pieces ensure performance, practicality and visibility in low-light conditions.

Key Features

  • Lightweight technical hood and pant set for multi-terrain outdoor use
  • 4-way stretch grid fabric for flexibility and unrestricted movement
  • Power mesh ventilation on the hood for enhanced breathability
  • Durable water-repellent (DWR) finish for light weather protection
  • Zipped pockets on the short and secure zip pockets on the hood
  • Elasticated waistband with branded drawcord for a personalised fit
  • Flat elastic hood and cuffs for a streamlined silhouette
  • Reflective branding across both pieces for increased visibility

Ideal for: hiking, outdoor training, active travel and everyday performance wear.
